title: Felix and the Static
author: Rafael Eastwick
blurb: Juniper Marchetti, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
